I cannot promise that i will stay forever with you but as long as I am alive, i will always STAY by your side😊. You means soo much to me Stray kids😢 I will protect you and love all of you, Thank you for everything. STRAY KIDS you make STAYs stay😢

author: @BuSadeceBen
text:
Dear Bang Chan, Silent Cry is playing in the background as I write this letter.  I think I will cry.  I wrote this letter a long time ago, but I'm translating it now.  I don't know if you're reading this, I hope you do.

        “Dear Bang Chan Hyung, 

          I don't know if you will read this letter.  I'm writing this letter on a piece of paper and you probably won't read it.  I can deal with it.

          Yes, you have a big nose, but so do I.  If you find this ugly, it'll be fine with me.  You don't want us to get upset, do you?  Remember, the most important thing for us is your happiness. Your face is not crooked, different, ugly.  You don't realize it, but you have a very beautiful face.  Do you know what I would give to have that face?  You tell us we should love ourselves, but you don't love yourself.  Don't do this, love yourself.

          The reason I love you is not your looks!  Your heart is too beautiful to be true and we love it too... Your thoughts, words, look, smile, dimples, curly hair, sincerity... I love you with everything and in every way.
  
          Chris Hyung, you said no one could break or even touch STAY... But they did.  They made STAY very sad... What should I do Chris Hyung?  Should I fight them or stop talking?  What should I do to get them to stop messing with me?  I don't know. Really I have no idea. That killing me. I can't stop thinking, am I a bad person?  Is that why you didn't include me?  Is that why they didn't like me?  But I didn't do anything to them...

           I can tell you everything Hyung because I trust you.  I don't trust my family, my friends, or even myself.  But I trust you and I know that trust will never be wasted.

           People are evil and cruel.  Thank you for staying white in this world.  Thank you for loving and protecting us in this world.

           Oh- Youtiful is playing in the background and my tears are starting to flow.  I don't know why I made such a list, it's hard not to cry because Silent Cry and Youtiful are playing back to back.

           Take care of yourself, do not overwork your body.  Do the activities you love as much as you can.  You all deserve to rest, so get some rest.

        


With lots of love, respect and gratitude.

A Stay”
